{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I reckon that's the real reason we were trained to ambidextrous. To allow for those ''or'diniise'' in Procurement.|[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] "[[Atin Skirata|Atin]]"|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Darth Sidious Mandalore.png|thumb|360x360px|Darth Sidious wields [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|his dual lightsabers]], demonstrating ambidexterity.]]
'''Ambidexterity''' was the state of being equally adept in the use of both left and right [[Limb/Legends|appendages]] in [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were trained to be able to wield their issued [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] ambidextrously.<ref name="O66" /> All members of the [[Yevetha]] species were ambidextrous, and [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurians]] were identically proficient with their two largest appendages.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Ambidexterity could also be applied by [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="RCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> The [[Morgukai]] had been known to be ambidextrous; one such member was [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]], who defected to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

This quality was present in species with more than two hands, such as the [[Codru-Ji]], [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerians]], [[Noehon]]s, [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] and [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]]. In those cases, it was referred to as '''multidexterity'''.<ref name="UAA" />
